# КулЛиб (CoolLib)

> > A Russian digital library offering free ebook downloads in FB2 and other formats, featuring books, audiobooks, and extensive genre catalogs.

КулЛиб (CoolLib) is a comprehensive Russian-language digital library platform providing free access to books and audiobooks across 549+ genres. The site supports multiple formats including FB2, PDF, and features works by authors like Alain de Botton, Darya Grifina, Anastasia Volchok, Vasily Rozanov, and others, with OpenID authentication and FTP access.

## Key Topics

- КулЛиб (CoolLib platform)
- FB2 format (primary ebook format)
- Russian digital library
- Free ebook downloads
- Audiobooks (аудиокниги)
- Genre-based navigation (549 categories)
- ББК and УДК classification systems
- OpenID authentication
- OCR digitization
- FTP access
- Russian-language literature
- Author collections
- Online reading interface
- Book series collections

## Library Core

- [КулЛиб Homepage](https://coollib.cc/index.php): Main library homepage with access to free ebook downloads and online reading in FB2 format
- [Book Catalog](https://coollib.cc/book): Complete book catalog with filtering by author, genre, language, and format
- [New Books](https://coollib.cc/new): Recently added books and latest additions to the КулЛиб collection
- [Genre Directory](https://coollib.cc/g): Complete list of 549 book genres for browsing and navigation

## Books & Audiobooks

- [От пробирки до кастрюли (Online Reader)](https://coollib.cc/b/821665-anastasiya-volchok-ot-probirki-do-kastryuli-kak-uchenyie-razrabatyivayut-produktyi-kotoryie-myi-edim_/read): Anastasia Volchok's book on food science, available for online reading in FB2 format
- [Что ещё расскажешь? (Audiobook)](https://coollib.cc/ab/72627034-chto-eschyo-rasskazhesh): Audiobook by Darya Grifina, narrated by Litres professional voice actors
- [Почему в электросети нестабильное напряжение? (Audiobook)](https://coollib.cc/ab/73179823-pochemu-v-elektroseti-nestabilnoe-napryazhenie-i-chto-delat): Technical audiobook by Dmitry Podluzhny on electrical voltage stability
- [Что такое русский характер (Images)](https://coollib.cc/b/813256-vasiliy-vasilevich-rozanov-chto-takoe-russkiy-harakter-psihologiya-velikorossa/image): Image gallery for Vasily Rozanov's work on Russian character psychology

## Authors & Series

- [Ален Де Боттон (Alain de Botton)](https://coollib.cc/a/44263-alen-de-botton): Author page with biography and complete book collection
- [Military-Historical Library Series (PDF)](https://coollib.cc/s/17/pdf): Военно-историческая библиотека series collection in PDF format
